name: NovoGrad
description: Local NovoGrad implementation with per-parameter gradient norm second moments and momentum. Foreach, fused, and capturable are not claimed; DDP/FSDP/ZeRO compatibility matches a plain torch optimizer step on local parameters.

parameters.backend_options: forwarded to torch.optim.NovoGrad when available; otherwise beta1, beta2, eps

examples.title: Optimize a quadratic with NovoGrad
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.novograd import novograd

x = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor([3.0, -4.0]))
optimizer = novograd([x], lr=0.05)
loss = (x - torch.tensor([1.0, -2.0])).square().sum()
loss.backward()
optimizer.step()
